_info.description: Smallest didactic instance — 2 machine types, 2 jobs, 1 running job.
notes: budget B=20: total monetary spend must not exceed this.
type 0 (on-prem): free to use, perf=1, deploy=0, capacity=1 (only 1 slot).
type 1 (cloud):   costs money, perf=2 (twice as fast), deploy=1 (warmup),
io_time=0.5 per IO unit, unlimited capacity.
Running job (id=99): already occupying on-prem (type 0) at t=0, finishes at t=3.
Effect: on-prem capacity is fully used during [0,3); new jobs must wait or go cloud.
Zero-cost feasibility: both jobs must fit on-prem sequentially after the running job
frees the slot at t=3. job 0: t=3..7, job 1: t=7..11 → horizon must be >= 12.
Tradeoff: send job 0 on-prem (starts t=3, completes t=7, free) vs. cloud (starts t=0,
completes t=3, costs 6). On-prem is cheaper but slower due to the running job.
